title: Unit gradient of the distance function off a closed set (Simon 2.8 proof, C1(c))
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every closed nonempty S ⊆ ℝⁿ and every x ∈ ℝⁿ with x ∉ S such that d_S(y) := infDist(y, S) is Fréchet differentiable at x, the operator norm of its derivative is ‖fderiv ℝ d_S x‖ = 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Set (Rn n)) (x : Rn n), IsClosed S → S.Nonempty → x ∉ S → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y ↦ infDist y S) x → ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ infDist y S) x‖ = 1
